# Dialog

Modal window (role=dialog) over a blurred scrim. Focus is trapped and returns to the trigger; Escape and the close button dismiss. Sizes map to the overlay width tokens.

| Source    | [`packages/ui/src/components/dialog`](./)                                                                       |

## Import

```tsx
import { Dialog, DialogClose, DialogContent, DialogDescription, … } from "@cesuain/ui";
// or the per-component entry point
import { Dialog } from "@cesuain/ui/dialog";
```

## API

Exports: `Dialog`, `DialogClose`, `DialogContent`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogOverlay`, `DialogPortal`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogTrigger`.

Types: `DialogContentProps`.

Props, defaults and live examples are on the Storybook Docs page, generated from the TypeScript types.

## Accessibility

- Behaviour and semantics are summarized above; keyboard and screen reader behaviour follow the WAI-ARIA pattern of the underlying primitive.
- `dialog.test.tsx` covers rendering, variants and interaction with Testing Library and runs axe-core on the rendered output (contrast is checked at token level). Every story also runs axe-core's default rule set in the Storybook browser tests; violations fail the run.
- Colors come from semantic tokens whose contrast is checked in both themes by `pnpm tokens:check`.
